sources.title: MobileSAM | airockchip/rknn_model_zoo | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: MobileSAM (Mobile Segment Anything Model) is a lightweight version of the Segment Anything Model designed for efficient image segmentation on resource-constrained devices. This implementation enables running MobileSAM on Rockchip Neural Processing Units (NPUs), providing optimized performance for embedded systems.
